subject: general
question: What happens when you use the Format Painter tool in MS Word?

options.text: It copies formatting (e.g., font, color) from one piece of text to another.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It copies formatting (e.g., font, color) from one piece of text to another.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Format Painter tool in MS Word is used to **copy the formatting of text or objects** (such as font style, size, color, and paragraph settings) and apply it elsewhere.
 
• To use the Format Painter, **select the text** or object with the desired formatting, click on the Format Painter icon, and then **highlight the target text or object**.
 
• The Format Painter can be used **once or repeatedly**. Double-clicking the Format Painter icon allows you to apply the formatting to multiple areas until it is turned off.
 
• This tool is especially useful for **maintaining uniform formatting** in large documents, saving time and effort.
 
• The Format Painter is located in the **Home tab** on the MS Word ribbon, within the Clipboard group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Clipboard Group:**

 
 
• This group on the Home tab includes tools such as Cut, Copy, Paste, and Format Painter.
 
• It allows users to manage the transfer of text, images, or formatting between different parts of a document or across applications.
 
 
 
• **Shortcut Keys:**
 
 
• There is no default shortcut key for the Format Painter in MS Word, but users can assign one through the **Customize Ribbon or Quick Access Toolbar** options.
 
 
 
• **Application Across Office Suite:**
 
 
• The Format Painter is available not only in MS Word but also in other Microsoft Office applications like Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
 
• In Excel, it can be used to copy the formatting of cells, including borders, fill color, and text styles.
 
 
 
• **Alternative Methods:**
 
 
• Instead of using Format Painter, users can manually replicate formatting by using the **Font and Paragraph settings** in the Home tab.
 
• Another option is to use the **Styles feature** in Word for consistent formatting throughout the document.
